title: Chat gained two more places to wander
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: better chat options, upgraded image models, sturdier integrations, and fewer ways for credentials to escape into the wild.

Noir Ink Tattoo Studio and Synapse joined the chat lineup, while a fix cleaned up issues around thinking-enabled chats. More personalities, fewer mysterious pauses.

Seedream moved to 4.5, Seedance moved to Pro-Fast, and the image path now handles fallback behavior and dimension scaling more reliably.

Aqua API was added to vibeCoding, and Telegram image-to-image requests now correctly recognize files served through Telegram's CDN.
